measurement.dedupe: aggregate via consent-compatible native or first-party events; no raw IP/emails/fingerprints or order IDs; never mix click counts with purchases
measurement.gross_vs_net: net = settled owned receipts + cleared affiliate commissions - refunds - processing fees - chargebacks, with currency and transaction-period reconciliation
measurement.kpi: net / qualified human sessions * 1000 only when numerator, denominator and comparable cohorts verified
measurement.small_sample_warning: <30 paid orders/variant: exploratory, do not infer A/B superiority
